calls.title: Notion + GrowthBook
calls.summary: The team discussed the integration of Snowflake with GrowthBook, noting that while the Snowflake connection has been established, metric migration and SDK setup are delayed due to manual adjustments and additional time required for exposure forwarding. The Proof of Concept (POC) start is postponed to after July 4th to ensure quality setup. The onsite meeting is rescheduled for late July to align better with project timelines. Pricing discussions are deferred, as the team expressed concerns about potential high costs related to event forwarding. The procurement process was outlined, emphasizing legal review timelines and a preference for flexible, tiered pricing models. Ongoing communication will be maintained via Slack, with offline syncs planned for technical details.

calls.title: Notion<>GrowthBook - Onsite Meeting
calls.summary:
We need to summarize the sales call transcript in 2-3 sentences. Focus on what was discussed (product, features, pain points), key participants and roles, and next steps/action items.

Key participants: Sam (data product team at Notion), Snehal (same team), Jeff (data scientist), Luke (head of experimentation at GrowthBook), Graham (co-founder of GrowthBook), Jake (account team at GrowthBook). The call is between Notion team and GrowthBook team.

Discussion: GrowthBook's vision and roadmap, especially around AI and experimentation at scale. Features like AI data analyst, visual editor, feature flagging, monitored ramp-ups, cell-based rollouts, custom webhooks, learning library, experiment quality governance. Pain points: Notion has high experiment velocity, metric governance issues, difficulty capturing learning, need for reliable feature flagging and canary releases. Also compared GrowthBook vs Statsig on customization vs opinionated.

Next steps: Notion is running a PoC with real experiments over the next month. Jake will send a recap and example of support. Notion will share a list of differences they notice vs Statsig. Potential further calls to address items.

Summary: The meeting between Notion (Sam, Snehal, Jeff) and GrowthBook (Luke, Graham, Jake) covered GrowthBook's AI-driven experimentation roadmap, including feature flags, monitored rollouts, and learning aggregation, addressing Notion's pain points around scaling experiment velocity and metric governance
